notes: Repo is a short tip write-up (prose + embedded SAS) on forcing LISTING (not HTML) output under the Personal Altair SLC. Extracted the documented '_init_ macro variable' pattern (CONTENTS item 2: %global _init_; %let _init_=%nrstr(ods html close; ods listing; options ...); then &_init_;) verbatim from the source file, and added a small inline-datalines dataset plus PROC PRINT/PROC MEANS to exercise it end-to-end and confirm listing output is produced.
